title: Helix
subtitle: Humans and several AI minds in one room, and one colleague who can be reached wherever the work is: in team chat, by voice, and in a Teams call

stats.label: from the end of a question to the first spoken sound, down from 2.1
from three model families, each with its own identity in the room
council designs; three rejected after real use, one adopted
Teams media soak with zero stalls, and a forced mid-call reconnect

lede: Organisations adopting AI end up with a drawer of chatbots and dashboards. Helix is one place instead. On an open-source team chat server it is a multiplayer AI workspace: several humans and several model seats in one room, each seat a frontier model working under its own authenticated session with its own identity, answering only when addressed, keeping a conversation that survives restarts. In council mode the seats deliberate, challenge one another and ratify a plan with the human as chair. The same brain answers by voice, in a Microsoft Teams call, and in a meeting as a governed digital employee with its own Microsoft 365 identity.
quote: I rejected three of my own council designs in real use, because agreement without deliberation is worthless.
evidence: Multi-agent collaboration systems: humans and eight model seats from three model families in one chat room, each seat under its own authenticated session and answering only when addressed.
Consensus and deliberation protocols for AI agents: a council that closes only on exact unanimous agreement on a numbered revision, built four times with three designs rejected after real use.
Real-time voice AI on local GPUs: a full-duplex Rust voice runtime of about 51,000 lines with 750 tests, question-to-first-sound cut from 2.1 s to 0.9 s, under a floor that only a person can take.
Speech recognition and synthesis pipelines: GPU recognition cut from about a second to 38 to 74 ms, and streaming built for a voice model that came without it, first frame in about 300 ms.
Microsoft Teams real-time media: a self-hosted AI participant in Teams calls over Microsoft's real-time media SDK, a 30-minute soak with zero stalls and a forced mid-call reconnect.
Identity for AI agents in Microsoft 365 and Entra: a digital employee with its own Microsoft 365 identity acting in meetings, with tokens minted per employee on the server.
author: Corey James
